user.title: imhd.sk departures
user.description: What do you want to add?

menu_options.action: Only the action for one-off departure lookups

action.title: Departure lookup action
action.description:
Makes the “imhd.sk departures: Get departures” action (imhd_sk.get_departures) available. It fetches departures for any stop on request and returns them to a script or automation. No entities are created.

The action is also available whenever at least one stop is configured.

stop.title: Add a stop
stop.description: Pick a stop and how its departures should be updated.

data_description.stop: Pick from the list (nearest to home first, type to search), or paste an imhd.sk stop link or the stop number.
data_description.name: Device name in Home Assistant. Leave empty to use the stop name.
data_description.mode: Live: persistent connection, changes show up immediately. Periodic: downloads the board every few minutes. On request: never fetches on its own, only via the Refresh button or the “Update entity” action.
data_description.lines: Line numbers separated by commas, e.g. 61, 96. Limits departures and which lines get sensors. Empty means all lines.
data_description.max_departures: How many upcoming departures go into each sensor's “departures” attribute.
data_description.platform_sensors: Next departure from each platform (A, B…), i.e. each direction separately.
data_description.line_sensors: Next departure of each line in each direction, e.g. “Linka 96 · A”.

error.cannot_connect: imhd.sk returned no departures for this stop. Check the stop or try again later.
error.invalid_stop: The stop could not be recognised. Pick it from the list, paste an imhd.sk stop link or its number.

init.title: Stop settings
init.description: The update method can't be changed here. To change it, remove the stop and add it again.

data_description.lines: Line numbers separated by commas, e.g. 61, 96. Empty means all lines.
data_description.max_departures: How many upcoming departures go into each sensor's “departures” attribute.
data_description.platform_sensors: Next departure from each platform (A, B…), i.e. each direction separately.
data_description.line_sensors: Next departure of each line in each direction, e.g. “Linka 96 · A”.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to download the board, in minutes (1–60).

get_departures.name: Get departures
get_departures.description: Downloads the imhd.sk live board of a stop once and returns upcoming departures.

stop_id.name: Stop
stop_id.description: Stop number (e.g. 341) or an imhd.sk stop / live board link.

lines.name: Lines
lines.description: Line numbers separated by commas, e.g. 61, 96. Empty means all.

platforms.name: Platforms
platforms.description: Internal platform numbers separated by commas, e.g. 837. The response lists them with destinations under “platforms”.

limit.name: Number of departures
limit.description: At most this many departures are returned.

timeout.name: Time limit
timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds the lookup may take.

settle.name: Wait for completion
settle.description: Platforms arrive one by one. The board is considered complete once nothing new arrives for this many seconds. Increase if departures are missing.
